posts.summary_en: Datamine of game version 1.1.002. Skill haste uses the LoL-style formula: final CD = base CD × 100/(100+haste). Only the root skill cooldown is hasted. Internal delays of multi-stage skills, such as child spawn delays and dash intervals, are not. That is why haste seems to work differently per cookie.
mechanics: Final cooldown = base cooldown × 100 / (100 + H), with H = SkillHaste raw value / 10,000. Cooldown reduction = H/(100+H). Haste 10 -> 9.09%, 20 -> 16.67%, 50 -> 33.33%, 100 -> 50%, 200 -> 66.67%. No cap was found in the calc function.
Diminishing returns: haste 50 gives a 33% cooldown cut, not 50%. Example: 12 s base at 50 haste = 8 s.
No per-skill haste coefficient or IgnoreHaste tag exists in 1.1.002 data (901 Cooldown entries, 56 SkillZeroInitialCooldownModel). SkillZeroInitialCooldownTag makes the first cast instant.

Multi-stage skills: only the parent skill cooldown is hasted. SpawnDelay, durations and follow-up attack intervals are not. Example, Cream Soda (크림소다맛 쿠키): root CD 3.5 s -> 2.333 s at haste 50, while the 0.58 s and 1.10 s internal delays are unchanged. Example, 피겨여왕맛 쿠키: root CD 8 s -> 5.333 s at haste 50, while the 1 s gaps between its 4 dashes are unchanged.

Other reasons measured haste can look different: an animation or action lock can delay a recast after the cooldown ends (the gap grows at high haste); StateTriggerConditionModel skills need extra trigger conditions; frame/tick rounding; and role/element conditional haste bonuses (FinalStatData.AbilityHaste).
disagreements: Commenters conclude '25까지만 챙기는게 효율적' (only ~25 haste is efficient) for arena. This is the arena context, not raid.

posts.summary_en: Datamine of the crit system. Crit rate above 100% gives tiered crits: 1st/2nd/3rd-degree crits, where the integer part is guaranteed and the fraction is the chance of the next tier. Crit multiplier = 1 + tier × (0.5 + bonus crit dmg). Past 100% effective crit rate, crit damage is worth more per point than crit rate. Sugar-rune max per line is 8% for both crit rate and crit damage.

sugar_runes.stats: Max per sugar-rune line: 치확 8% and 치피 8% (equal)
sugar_runes.why: Past 100% base crit rate, stack 치피 on sugar runes instead of 치확

rng: Crit tier: N = floor(X) + Bernoulli(X - floor(X)). At 120% effective crit rate, 80% of hits are 1st-degree crits and 20% are 2nd-degree. At 150%: 50/50. At 235%: 65% 2nd-degree, 35% 3rd-degree.
mechanics: Base crit damage multiplier 1.5× (bonus crit dmg 0).
Crit dmg multiplier = 1 + crit tier × final crit dmg rate, where final rate = base 50% + bonus crit dmg. With bonus 30%: 1st = 1.8×, 2nd = 2.6×, 3rd = 3.4×.
Crit rate over 100% does not waste. It rolls higher-tier crits (200% = always 2nd-degree, 300% = always 3rd-degree).

Marginal value of +10% crit rate is always +0.10× expected. +10% crit dmg adds (effective crit rate × 0.1): 0.025× at 25% CR, 0.10× at 100%, 0.15× at 150%, 0.30× at 300%. Crit rate is better below 100% effective, they are equal at 100%, and crit dmg is better above 100%.
Crit resistance on the target lowers effective crit rate, so judge by effective CR after resistance (relevant to arena).
disagreements: Commenter: in arena everyone has ~60% 치저, so skip 치피 there. Another commenter: PvE players should take 치피 and arena players 치확.

quotes.kr: 치명타 데미지 수식: 1 + 치명타 단계 * (0.5 + 추가 치명타 데미지)
quotes.en: Crit damage formula: 1 + crit tier × (0.5 + bonus crit damage)

posts.summary_en: Official dev notice. Listed cookies include 다크초코 쿠키. Sugar runes spent on the listed cookies are refunded in full on 9/1 18:00 KST.

posts.summary_en: Lift resistance shortens airborne time; it is not a chance to ignore the lift. Resistances combine multiplicatively, and a skill is cancelled if the cookie is airborne for 0.4 s or more. Base 20% + Pinot Noir 35% = 48%, and adding the Panda Dumpling pet's 20% gives 64%, so a 1 s lift drops to 0.36 s and no longer cancels skills. The OP also gives lift durations for several cookies.
mechanics: Final lift resistance = base + extra − (base × extra). Airborne time = original × (1 − final resistance).
A cookie airborne for 0.4 s or more has its current skill cancelled. Under 0.4 s it lifts briefly but the skill continues.
All cookies have 20% base lift resistance. A 1 s lift becomes 0.8 s, so the skill is cancelled.
피노누아 (Pinot Noir) buff: +35% lift resistance to allies, 10 s duration, 9.5 s skill CD, max 1 stack (re-cast only refreshes), dispellable. It is effectively always up.
Base + Pinot: 20% + 35% − 7% = 48%. A 1 s lift becomes 0.52 s (cancelled); a 0.75 s lift becomes 0.39 s (not cancelled).
Pinot + 판다만두 pet (20%): extra = 35% + 20% = 55%, and 20% + 55% − 11% = 64%. A 1 s lift becomes 0.36 s, so the skill is not cancelled.
Lift resistance does not reduce damage, does not apply to knockback, stun or root, is separate from focus/resist rolls, and does not shorten a lift already in progress.

OP's lift durations (comment): 크림소다 0.3 s; 코코아, 슈크림, 복숭아, 이온, 에스프레소, 요거트베리, 찰스 etc. 0.4 s; 용감한 쿠키 and 근육맛 0.45 s at low tier, 0.6 s at high tier; 쿨링민트 0.4 s -> 0.6 s; 이름 모를 케이크 들개 1.2 s. Monsters all differ. The boss's lift duration is unknown.
disagreements: Commenter: with base 20% a 0.4 s lift becomes 0.32 s, so it wouldn't cancel. The thread links this to Pomegranate being interrupted by 슈크림.
Commenter lolhhkyne: Pinot's buff isn't boosted by skill amp either, so the Panda pet is the only other option.

posts.summary_en: Tested on a Lv.1 GingerBrave with Milk (Lv.100) and Cheesecake (Lv.91). Cheesecake's ATK buff has priority over Milk's: a cookie that gets Cheesecake's buff loses Milk's. Milk buffed by Cheesecake gives a much larger ATK buff, but only to cookies that did not also get Cheesecake's buff. So in conquest you want Cheesecake to buff Milk while the dealers dodge Cheesecake's buff, which the thread treats as a retry-lottery.

mechanics: GingerBrave (Lv.1) ATK readings. Milk buff only: 483K. Cheesecake buff only: 228K. Both: 228K (Milk's is overridden). Cheesecake-buffed Milk's buff only: 667K. Cheesecake-buffed Milk's buff plus Cheesecake buff: 228K. DEF 97,446, HP 1M 103K, CR 150.15%, crit res 46.65%, CD 131.38%, DR 13.56%, move speed 4 (all constant).
Buff priority: 치케 buff > 우유 buff. Commenter's explanation: Milk's is a stacking buff while Cheesecake's is a one-shot 50%.

posts.summary_en: 초코초코케이크 shares a Google Sheets/Excel final-damage calculator meant to settle the Pomegranate-buff debate. It includes a sugar-rune recommendation mode, and 66636 shows its output. The author twice corrected errors: once in the rune-comparison logic, and once in the crit formula after a commenter caught it. The crit fix changes results by about 6% in the file's current example.
mechanics: Calculator link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17IzI0esvzaXN4U54e7fH8Ml_6W-vhH0r/copy
The calculator gives min, max and average damage by crit rate.
Crit expected-value correction from commenter: average crit coefficient = 1 + (CR/100)×(CD/100). The old sheet formula went negative when CR and CD were below 100%.
disagreements: Commenter: average crit coefficient should be 1+(CR)(CD), e.g. CR 50%, CD 150% gives 1.75. The author first objected ('should be 1.25'), then agreed and fixed the sheet. The difference is about 6% in the current example. Note this differs from 31349's tiered model (1 + tier×(0.5+bonus)) unless 'CD' means total crit dmg.

rng: Macaron buff stacks (0/5/10) are the main swing in the calculator. For the same runes, 10 stacks is about 2.3× 0 stacks (829M vs 357M current; 1583M vs 630M recommended).
mechanics: The sheet models Pomegranate as buffing the top-N ATK cookies (석류 대상 수 = 5, excluding itself). Hence the '석류 수혜에 필요한 최소 공증' logic: Macaron and Ceylon take just enough ATK% to rank into the top 5.
Author's stated assumptions: Macaron's buff always lands, Milk's buff always lands, Cheesecake always buffs Milk, and Figure's and Ceylon's buffs always land.
Body rule: a dealer that receives Pomegranate's buff is best with all crit dmg; one that doesn't is best with all skill amp, which beats a crit rate/crit dmg mix on final damage.
Top-5 alternatives are within 0.4–0.8% of each other (1.908× vs 1.900× vs 1.899× at 10 stacks), so small rune variations barely matter once the recipient set is right.
disagreements: The body says Pomegranate-buffed dealers should go 'all crit dmg'. The sheet does that only at 10 Macaron stacks; at 5, 0 and 'stable' it recommends all crit rate (치8) for 시커 and 전갈.
Commenter: they heard 치케 is better with 스가, against the author's all-스증.
Commenter: getting Ceylon into Pomegranate's buff is hell ('실론이 석류 받는 게 헬이네').
